qualifications.details: The implemented per-batch term is mean(1[parent IoU >= .5] * clamp_min(parent IoU - refined-selected IoU, 0)) on the existing eligible-fit batches. def single(x): return struct.unpack('<f',struct.pack('<f',x))[0]
def iou_xywh(b,t):
    b=[single(v) for v in b];t=[single(v) for v in t]
    right=[min(single(b[i]+b[i+2]),single(t[i]+t[i+2])) for i in [0,1]]
    left=[max(b[i],t[i]) for i in [0,1]]
    size=[max(0.0,single(right[i]-left[i])) for i in [0,1]]
    inter=single(size[0]*size[1])
    area_b=single(b[2]*b[3]); area_t=single(t[2]*t[3])
    union=single(single(area_b+area_t)-inter)
    assert union>0
    v=single(inter/union)
    assert math.isfinite(v) and 0<=v<=1
    return v
def iou_xyxy(b,t):
    b=[single(v) for v in b];t=[single(v) for v in t]
    br=[single(b[i]+b[i+2]) for i in [0,1]]
    tr=[single(t[i]+t[i+2]) for i in [0,1]]
    extent=[max(0.0,single(min(br[i],tr[i])-max(b[i],t[i]))) for i in [0,1]]
    inter=single(extent[0]*extent[1])
    area_b=single(single(br[0]-b[0])*single(br[1]-b[1]))
    area_t=single(single(tr[0]-t[0])*single(tr[1]-t[1]))
    return single(inter/single(single(area_b+area_t)-inter))
